reuse.why: Introduces one guard and calls it from every existing link handler; nothing in the tree already offered this check.

duplication.why: The query and error live once in assertBankAccountNotLinked; handlers only pass their provider and ids.

placement.why: The guard sits next to the link handlers in accounts/app.ts and runs before any write, where the tree keeps link logic.

scope.why: Only the guard, five call lines and a release note.

maintainability.why: A single, clearly named guard defines what counts as linked for all providers and is easy to extend.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All five link handlers call the new shared guard.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in accounts/app.ts, called by linkGoCardlessAccount, linkSimpleFinAccount, linkPluggyAiAccount, linkAkahuAccount and linkEnableBankingAccount.
